instruction: Speak in Italian. Tell the story by starting at a normal pace and pitch, then speeding up and raising your pitch for the exciting middle part, and finally slowing down and lowering your pitch back to normal for the calm ending.
text: La gara stava per finire, ed eravamo secondi. All'ultima curva, il nostro pilota ha visto un'apertura, un'occasione quasi impossibile. Ha spinto l'acceleratore al massimo, ha superato il rivale all'interno con una manovra da brivido e ha tagliato il traguardo per primo! Dopo tutta quella tensione, la vittoria è stata ancora più dolce.

target_values.pitch: start normal, rise to high in the middle, then return to normal
target_values.speed: start normal, get fast in the middle, then slow down at the end

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio cuts off abruptly during the first sentence, completely failing to execute the requested dynamic progression in speed and pitch.

instruction_evidence.pitch: The audio ends prematurely, making it impossible to evaluate the pitch rise in the middle or the return to normal.
instruction_evidence.speed: The audio is cut off before the middle part, so no speed variation is present.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not applicable due to level 1 score.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not applicable due to level 1 score.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Begin your speech at a slow tempo, and steadily accelerate until you're speaking very quickly by the final words.
text: All'inizio era solo un sussurro, il vento tra le foglie. Poi le prime gocce di pioggia, rade e pesanti. Le nuvole si sono addensate, oscurando il cielo, e il tuono in lontananza è diventato un rombo costante e vicino, fino a scatenare tutta la sua furia sulla città.

target_values.speed: start slow, gradually accelerate to very fast by the end

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio starts slowly but fails to accelerate. The pacing remains uniformly slow and unnatural throughout the entire text, completely ignoring the instruction to end very quickly.

instruction_evidence.tempo_start: The audio correctly starts at a slow tempo.
instruction_evidence.tempo_progression: There is no acceleration; the speaker maintains a slow pace until the very end, failing the dynamic requirement.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not applicable due to low instruction-following score. The delivery is extremely unnatural and disjointed anyway.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not applicable due to low instruction-following score.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Start with a cheerful voice at a normal conversational speed. Then, slow your pace and become more reflective. For the final part, maintain the slow pace but let your voice fill with sadness.
text: Ah, quella canzone! Mi riporta subito a quella festa, che serata magnifica fu. Ballammo tutta la notte senza un pensiero al mondo. Era un momento perfetto, uno di quelli che credi non finiranno mai. Peccato che sia finito.

target_values.emotion: start happy, become thoughtful in the middle, and end on a sad note
target_values.speed: start normal, slow down in the middle, and remain slow

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio is cut off early and completely fails to demonstrate the requested dynamic progression in emotion and speed. The delivery is also distorted and yelled rather than cheerful at a normal speed.

instruction_evidence.dynamic_progression: Not present; the audio ends prematurely before any changes in pace or emotion can occur.
instruction_evidence.cheerful_start: The voice sounds aggressively yelled and distorted rather than naturally cheerful.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Start speaking slowly and hesitantly, as if nervous. As you continue, your speed should become normal and your tone should grow firm and confident.
text: Uhm... buongiorno a tutti. Vorrei... vorrei iniziare ringraziandovi per essere qui oggi. Siamo riuniti per annunciare un'iniziativa di grande importanza per la nostra comunità, un progetto che porterà crescita e nuove opportunità per tutti.

target_values.speed: start slow and hesitant, then become a normal speaking speed
target_values.tone: start hesitant, then become firm and confident

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to realize the requested dynamic progression; the speaker remains slow and nervous throughout the entire recording without ever transitioning to a firm and confident tone at a normal speed.

instruction_evidence.speed: Starts very slowly and hesitantly but fails to transition to a normal speed later on.
instruction_evidence.tone: Starts nervous but never becomes firm and confident; the hesitant, weak delivery persists until the end.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Start with a worried tone. Then, as you continue, transition to a tone of surprise. End the sentence sounding very happy and relieved.
text: Non ho ancora ricevuto nessuna notizia, spero davvero che non sia successo niente di grave. Aspetta un attimo, è arrivata una mail... non posso crederci. È incredibile, ce l'abbiamo fatta! È la notizia migliore che potessi ricevere!

target_values.emotion: begin worried, then transition to surprised, and end happy

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The temporal progression from worried to surprised to happy is audible, but the execution is heavily disjointed, overly mechanical, and structurally imperfect, making the transitions feel unnatural rather than rich.

instruction_evidence.worried_tone: The beginning is slow, hesitant, and low-pitched, attempting a worried feel but sounding very choppy.
instruction_evidence.surprised_tone: There is a slight increase in tempo and pitch in the middle, but it lacks genuine expressive richness.
instruction_evidence.happy_relieved_tone: The end becomes louder and more exclamatory, but the delivery remains extremely robotic and broken.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The audio is extremely disjointed, halting, and heavily synthetic.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The expressive variation is clumsy and severely hindered by the poor synthesis quality.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Your delivery should sound like you're losing energy. Begin loud and fast, but end very quiet and slow.
text: Non riesco a credere a tutto quello che ho fatto oggi, un'impresa dopo l'altra senza un minuto di pausa! Mi sentivo invincibile, capace di conquistare il mondo. Ma ora che tutto è finito, sento tutta la stanchezza che mi crolla addosso... sono completamente esausto.

target_values.speed: start fast and end very slow
target_values.volume: start loud and end very quiet

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio demonstrates a noticeable decrease in speaking speed from beginning to end, but the requested volume contrast (loud to very quiet) is weak and mostly stays within a normal range.

instruction_evidence.speed: The audio starts at a fast pace and gradually slows down towards the end.
instruction_evidence.volume: The volume starts at a normal level rather than loud, and only drops slightly at the end, failing to reach the requested 'very quiet' level.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds highly synthetic with prominent mispronunciations and unnatural prosody.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery lacks the expressive richness needed to convey the feeling of genuinely losing energy.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Start in a quiet, sad voice. About halfway through, your tone should shift to become loud and angry.
text: Ricordo ancora le loro promesse, le parole gentili che mi dissero quel giorno. Ci ho creduto, ho dato tutto quello che avevo. E poi, il silenzio. Mi hanno lasciato solo, hanno preso tutto e non si sono nemmeno guardati indietro. Non lo perdonerò mai! Mai!

target_values.emotion: start sad, then shift to angry
target_values.volume: start quiet, then become very loud

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio has a shift in volume from quiet to loud, but the emotional shift from sad to angry is poorly realized. The start sounds rushed and flat rather than sad, and the anger is mainly expressed as a strained shout at the very end.

instruction_evidence.start_quiet_sad: The beginning is quieter but lacks any discernible sad emotion, sounding rushed and mumbled.
instruction_evidence.shift_loud_angry: There is a volume increase in the second half, peaking at the final words, but it lacks convincing angry affect and mostly sounds like a sudden, strained shout.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds highly synthetic, rushed, and has noticeable articulation artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional expression is severely lacking, and the transition feels unnatural and forced.

instruction: Speak in Italian. The delivery should start high-pitched and pleading, but shift decisively to a low-pitched, firm and defiant tone for the final part.
text: Potresti almeno considerare quello che sto dicendo? È importante per me, davvero. Ho seguito le tue regole finora, ho fatto quello che volevi. Ma questa volta, le cose cambiano. Io scelgo per me stessa.

target_values.tone: start with a pleading tone, then become defiant

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The pitch shift from high to low is clearly audible, but extreme artificial distortion and robotic effects severely hinder the realization of the emotional tones (pleading and defiant), making the overall execution weak and mechanical.

instruction_evidence.pitch: The audio starts with an artificially high pitch and abruptly drops to an artificially low pitch for the final part.
instruction_evidence.tone: While the pitch changes, the intended pleading and defiant emotions are masked by severe robotic artifacts, resulting in a lack of true emotional richness.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech suffers from massive distortion, robotic echoing, and unnatural artificial pitch shifting.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The severe audio artifacts override and obscure any genuine expressive shaping.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Your voice should build in urgency. Start at a normal level and gradually increase your speed and volume, making your tone more and more insistent.
text: Vi informiamo che è stata rilevata una criticità nel sistema di contenimento. Il personale sta monitorando la situazione, ma per precauzione è necessario agire ora. Abbandonate l'edificio usando le uscite di emergenza, non usate gli ascensori, muovetevi in fretta!

target_values.speed: progress from normal to very fast
target_values.volume: progress from normal to very loud

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio completely contradicts the progression requested in the instruction. Instead of gradually increasing in speed and urgency, the delivery starts fast and then significantly slows down, ending in a disjointed, staccato manner.

instruction_evidence.speed: The pace decreases throughout the recording, culminating in a very slow and broken delivery at the end, which is the exact opposite of the requested progression.
instruction_evidence.volume_and_tone: The volume does not meaningfully increase to 'very loud', and the disjointed ending completely fails to convey an increasingly urgent or insistent tone.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Your tone should evolve from indifferent to heavily sarcastic. The sarcasm should build gradually, not be present from the start.
text: Va bene, ho sentito quello che hai detto. È un approccio interessante, non c'è che dire. Ci devo riflettere un attimo. Oh sì, è chiaramente la soluzione perfetta a tutti i nostri problemi. Fantastico.

target_values.tone: start indifferent, but gradually become more sarcastic

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to show the requested dynamic progression. The delivery remains flat, disjointed, and monotonous throughout, with no audible transition to sarcasm.

instruction_evidence.indifferent_start: The beginning is flat and disjointed, which could pass as indifferent but sounds more robotic.
instruction_evidence.sarcastic_progression: There is no gradual build-up of sarcasm; the latter half of the text is delivered with the exact same flat, monotonous tone as the beginning.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Start by reading the text in a neutral, slow, and methodical way. Then, when you get to the unexpected part, suddenly shift to a surprised and much faster tone.
text: Secondo il rapporto annuale, il numero di incidenti è aumentato del quindici percento rispetto all'anno precedente. Le misure di prevenzione sembrano essere efficaci solo in parte... ma aspetta, qui dice che il novanta percento degli incidenti è stato causato da un singolo errore? Non è possibile!

target_values.emotion: start neutral, then abruptly become surprised
target_values.speed: start slow, then abruptly become faster

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio features a noticeable increase in speed during the second part, but the extremely robotic and stuttered delivery severely flattens the intended 'methodical' and 'surprised' emotions.

instruction_evidence.speed: The first half is very slow and disjointed; the second half increases in speed, though it remains clunky.
instruction_evidence.emotion: The intended shift from neutral to surprised is very weak, overshadowed by the highly unnatural, broken cadence.
